subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this memory/context umbrella stay as one maintainer design item, or be split into scoped product/security design issues for metrics, session handoff, semantic recall defaults, and restart preload?
rationale: The remaining work is not one code defect; it defines new API, default, visibility, privacy, storage, and gateway lifecycle behavior across stable memory/session/gateway surfaces.

options.title: Split into scoped design items
options.body: Create narrower design issues for metrics visibility, session/context handoff, semantic recall scope, and restart preload so each can get privacy, default, and validation criteria before implementation.

options.title: Keep one canonical umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the coordination point and require future PRs to state which slice they implement and how they avoid conflicting current surfaces.

options.title: Close only after replacements exist
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers explicitly decide narrower related issues fully preserve the remaining requirements.

recommendation.title: Split into scoped design items
recommendation.body: Create narrower design issues for metrics visibility, session/context handoff, semantic recall scope, and restart preload so each can get privacy, default, and validation criteria before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from prior review plus memory-search, usage, and QMD startup history.
